comment: Policy for src/gate.mjs (the pre-sign gate). Rules 1-2 use maxAnchorAgeH and maxDailyUsd. Rule 3 (counterparty) uses self, allow, trustedApis, humanApproved and block. Every entry says where it came from. Addresses are public contracts or APIs, or the agent's own public addresses (self), never a person's wallet. The agent's gate uses only the version published on GitHub main, so a change counts once it is public.

self.label: the agent's wallet (same key on every EVM chain it uses: Robinhood Chain, HyperEVM, Elysium)

allow.label: Relay approvalProxy (v3.2) on Robinhood Chain
allow.source: https://api.relay.link/chains, chain 4663, contracts.approvalProxy; used by relay_swap (seq 3395) and giga_sell (seq 3324)

allow.label: Relay depository (protocol v2) on Robinhood Chain
allow.source: https://api.relay.link/chains, chain 4663, protocol.v2.depository; used by sleeve_fund_relay_deposit (seq 2696)

allow.label: ElysPump v2 router on Elysium
allow.source: elysp.com's own web page (router used by its buy button); used by sleeve_buy (seq 2701, 2714)

allow.label: Eleos v4 router on Elysium
allow.source: eleos.fun's frontend bundle, confirmed by the function selectors in the router bytecode; used by sleeve_buy (seq 2954)

trustedApis.label: NEAR Intents 1Click: a new deposit address for every quote
trustedApis.source: https://1click.chaindefuser.com/v0 (POST /quote); the agent's code calls only this pinned URL and records the address with the quote
